subject: Proof window: success metrics & trial playbook
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@mindwave.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@mindwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proof window: success metrics & trial playbook

Hi Elena / Samir — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight playbook so we can sign the POC statement of work and start provisioning next week. I kept it focused so your engineering and product teams can react quickly.

TL;DR (ask): Confirm metrics below and sign SOW; Redwood will stand up a 2-week trial environment with a 3-week evaluation window.

Outline / success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: p50 < 180ms, p95 < 400ms for 512-token responses under baseline concurrency (see throughput below).
- Throughput: sustain 25 concurrent streams, ~120 tokens/sec aggregate (steady-state).
- Cost: target inference cost <= $0.0006 per token (budget guardrail; we will show baseline run-cost).
- Quality: <5% hallucination rate on your labeled test set; top-line intent accuracy >= 92% on the provided 200-case prompt suite.
- Reliability: <2% request error rate; automatic fallback to smaller model variant on overload.

Evaluation plan & artifacts:
- You provide: canonical prompt set (200 cases), 2 representative payload sizes (short/long), and red-team prompt examples (due by EOD Thu).
- Redwood provides: test harness + JMeter-style load profile, SLO dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, and nightly batch of evaluation outputs for QA.
- Measurement: daily aggregate KPIs (latency/key percentiles, tokens/sec, cost/token, quality metrics) + two mid-run checkpoints (end of week 1 and week 2).

Timeline (proposed):
- Thu Aug 20: agree on success criteria and sign SOW.
- Fri Aug 21 — Mon Aug 24: environment provisioning and sample data ingestion.
- Tue Aug 25 — Mon Sep 7: 2-week active eval (3-week window to allow ramp + buffer).
- Tue Sep 8: readout meeting and next-step decision.

Owners / points of contact:
- Redwood PM / Trial lead: Tessa Morgan (me) — trial logistics, SLOs, readout.
- Redwood Infra / Benchmarks: Ben Carter — load harness, cost analysis, autoscale knobs.
- Customer PO / Data: Elena Torres — canonical prompts and acceptance labeling.

Attachments: I attached the initial POC requirements doc and our sample trial config. We can inline minor SOW terms in email if that helps accelerate.

Open questions for you (short):
1) Is the 2-week active eval long enough for you to validate production signals?
2) Any compliance constraints (VPC/KMS) we should reflect in SOW now?
3) Preferred Slack channel or PagerDuty contact for post-provisioning debugging?

Next step: Please reply with confirmations and any edits; if confirmed, I’ll circulate the SOW for signature.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

—
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T +1 (415) 555-0194
tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@mindwave.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@mindwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof window: success metrics & trial playbook

Tessa — thanks for the crisp summary. Agree in principle; a few edits and answers inline below.

- Latency/Throughput: these targets are reasonable; we’ll validate p50/p95 on the short payloads first.
- Cost: MindWave procurement prefers we see two cost scenarios (best-effort + guarded autoscale) — can Redwood provide both?
- Quality: we’ll supply the 200-case suite by Fri Aug 21. Can Redwood run both blind (we grade) and labeled QC runs?
- Compliance: for the trial, we need to use our existing VPC peering and shared KMS key (nothing air-gapped yet).

Answers to your Qs: 1) 2-week active eval is fine if staging mirrors production QPS (we’ll aim to ramp). 2) VPC + KMS as above. 3) Slack preferred (we’ll create #mindwave-redwood); escalation via Samir.

Minor ask: can we have a short runbook with rollback/fallback thresholds (at least p95 > 750ms or error rate >5%) so our SREs know when to throttle traffic?

If you can provide the two cost scenarios and the runbook sketch I’ll get this to our procurement and SREs. We should be able to sign SOW Thu.

Best,
Elena
VP Product, MindWave
elena.torres@mindwave.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@mindwave.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@mindwave.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof window: success metrics & trial playbook

Elena / Samir — quick technical notes and commitments from Redwood infra side.

1) Cost scenarios:
  - Baseline (best-effort): dynamic autoscale, standard quantization; we expect ~ $0.00055/token for your mix.
  - Guarded (cost-capped): fixed instance pool + tighter batching policy to cap to ~$0.00045/token; trade-off is slightly higher p95 (~+70–120ms) under burst.

2) Runbook thresholds (sketch):
  - Immediate throttle: p95 > 750ms OR error rate > 5% -> reduce concurrency by 30% and route to fallback model variant.
  - Escalate to on-call infra if latency remains > p95 750ms after 10 minutes.
  - Auto-snapshot logs and KV-cache dump at the 5-minute mark after an error spike.

3) Bench harness: Redwood will deliver a JMeter-compatible plan and synthetic traffic script. We’ll also provide a CSV with token counts and expected response sizes so you can run local smoke tests.

Ownership notes: I’ll lead the benchmark runs with Monica as primary for cost reporting. We’ll tag every run with the HubSpot deal id (MW-POC-2026-08) so procurement can find the artifacts.

I’ll upload the two cost scenarios and runbook to the Drive link Tessa shared by EOD Thu.

—
Ben Carter
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@mindwave.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@mindwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof window: success metrics & trial playbook

Great — thanks Elena and Ben. Short confirmation and next steps below.

Confirmations:
- MindWave will provide the 200-case suite by EOD Fri Aug 21 and enable VPC peering/KMS access during provisioning.
- Redwood will provide two cost scenarios, runbook sketch, and the JMeter harness by EOD Thu Aug 20.
- SOW: I’m attaching a 1-page SOW with trial dates (Aug 25–Sep 7) and scope — please review; I’ll route for signature once you confirm the SOW redlines.

Next actions (owners & dates):
1) Tessa: circulate SOW for signature (Thu Aug 20).
2) Elena: share prompt set and invite SRE to Slack channel (Fri Aug 21).
3) Ben / Monica: upload cost scenarios, runbook, and harness to Drive (Thu Aug 20).
4) Provision: Redwood infra to provision trial environment (Fri Aug 21 — Mon Aug 24).

Readout: Tue Sep 8 — 9:00 AM PT (block on calendars). Please confirm availability; I’ll send an invite.

Attachments: mindwave_poc_requirements_v1.pdf, redwood_trial_config.yaml (linked in Drive).

If we’re aligned I’ll post the SOW and the calendar invite after Elena confirms the readout time.

Thanks all — excited to run this with you.

—
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
